title: Keeping Fuzzers on Duty: Repairing Fuzzing Build Breakages in Continuous Open-Source Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2611.06358v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous fuzzing platforms such as OSS-Fuzz provide sustained security testing for open-source projects, but long-term build breakages reduce security coverage and waste infrastructure resources. In OSS-Fuzz, around 20% of integrated projects remain in build-failure states, leaving their fuzzers off duty. These failures expose a maintenance gap between platform maintainers, who lack project-specific context, and project maintainers, who often lack fuzzing and infrastructure expertise. Existing program-repair techniques cannot be directly applied because fuzz build breakages span evolving project and infrastructure artifacts and require repeated infrastructure-aware diagnosis. We present FuzzMedic, an automated agent for fuzz build repair. FuzzMedic performs evidence-guided diagnosis across project and fuzzing-infrastructure artifacts. It explores repairs over a repair-state graph (RSG) that records the evolving workspace and build feed

translated_title: 让模糊测试器持续值守：修复持续开源模糊测试中的构建故障
translated_abstract: 诸如 OSS-Fuzz 等持续模糊测试平台为开源项目提供持续的安全测试，但长期的构建故障会降低安全覆盖率并浪费基础设施资源。在 OSS-Fuzz 中，约 20% 的已集成项目仍处于构建失败状态，导致其模糊测试器“离岗”停用。这些故障暴露出平台维护者与项目维护者之间的维护鸿沟：前者缺乏项目特定的背景信息，后者往往缺乏模糊测试与基础设施方面的专业知识。由于模糊测试构建故障涉及不断演进的项目与基础设施构件，且需要反复进行基础设施感知的诊断，现有的程序修复技术无法直接应用。我们提出了 FuzzMedic，一个用于模糊测试构建修复的自动化智能体。FuzzMedic 在项目构件与模糊测试基础设施构件之间执行证据引导的诊断，并在一个记录不断演进的工作区与构建反馈的修复状态图（RSG）上探索修复方案。
tldr: 提出 FuzzMedic，一个通过跨项目与基础设施构件的证据引导诊断、并在修复状态图上探索修复方案，从而自动修复 OSS-Fuzz 等持续开源模糊测试平台构建故障的自动化智能体。
